item.title: [Ada Derana Biz English] Now delivering: Uber Eats expands to Badulla, Bandarawela & Ella
item.description:
Continued expansion brings Uber Eats to more communities across Sri Lanka
Uber Eats is now live across Badulla, Bandarawela and Ella, bringing the convenience of delivery to a region known for its Ceylon tea and landmarks such as Ella’s iconic Nine Arch Bridge. Locals and tourists can now enjoy their favourite meals – from a comforting rice and curry meal, to short eats, or their morning coffee – delivered right to their doorstep. item.title: [Ada Derana Biz English] Cambridge Strengthens Its Commitment to Sri Lanka With New World Trade Center Office
item.description:
Cambridge University Press & Assessment has strengthened its presence in Sri Lanka with a new office at the World Trade Center, Colombo, and a directly employed local team through Cambridge University Press & Assessment Lanka (Pvt) Ltd from 1 August 2026.
The development reflects Cambridge’s continued commitment to Sri Lanka and its investment in local capability, bringing its teams closer to the schools, educators, institutions, partners and communities they support across the country.
